take: Toronto announced it placed right defenseman Christopher Tanev on injured reserve and recalled left defenseman Marshall Rifai from the AHL's Toronto club. Rifai has played two games for the Leafs this season, scoring once, but his 28 percent share of expected goals (a measure of chance quality) at five-on-five is weak, and Toronto fared 15.7 points worse in that share with him on the ice. Going by how the coach has used his defensemen, Nick Blankenburg is next in line for Tanev's minutes.
